Add camellia auth session baseline (#42)

## Summary
- add the real camellia `/login` flow for woodii staging with redirect support
- persist token, user, and access payloads in `localStorage` and expose shared auth/session helpers
- inject `Authorization` and `x-app: woodii` through the shared API client and clear state on `401`/`403`/`KICK_OUT`
- protect console routes, refresh the current user from `/api/v1/user/inspect`, and add a staging auth smoke script

## Testing
- `cd bougainvillea && pnpm run check:camellia`
- `cd bougainvillea && node scripts/camellia-auth-smoke.mjs`
